description: This file defines the VerticalYAxisRenderer class, a specialized renderer for drawing and formatting the vertical Y-axis in a charting library, specifically for 2D Column and Line charts. It includes methods for initialization, calculating space requirements, rendering axes, tick marks, labels, and titles, and computing axis scaling based on chart data.

classes.name: VerticalYAxisRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class responsible for drawing and calculating the layout of the vertical Y-axis in a chart, including tick marks, labels, titles, and scaling based on chart data.

methods.name: VerticalYAxisRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with specified parameters.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the renderer info for the Y axis based on chart data and settings.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the required space for the Y axis, including tick labels and title, and sets the dimensions.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the Y axis, including tick marks, labels, axis line, and title.

methods.name: InitScale
methods.description: Calculates scale parameters such as minimum and maximum Y values and tick spacing.

methods.name: GetTickMarkPos
methods.description: Determines the start and end positions for major and minor tick marks based on tick mark types.

methods.name: CalcYAxis
methods.description: Calculates the smallest and largest data values across all series in the chart to set axis scale.
